name: NASA FIRMS VIIRS 375 m detections kept for 2025-CALFD-000738
rule: Kept: VIIRS detections from the fire's start (7 January 2025 18:30 UTC, CAL FIRE) to its containment (31 January), whose pixel centre lies inside the official perimeter or within 375 m of it (one VIIRS pixel). Not kept: detections before the start (ten on 1 January belong to an earlier fire) and those farther from the perimeter (other fires or edge pixels).
